The '''Senators of Rhythm''' were a band playing in the [[Dealer's Den]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. They consisted of two [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] dancers, a [[Human/Legends|human]] dancer, an [[Advozse/Legends|Advozse]] playing the [[Nalargon/Legends|Nalargon]], and four [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] on the [[Kloo horn/Legends|Kloo horn]].<ref name="TOR" />
